paragraphs: Rabbah bar Rav Huna Zuti. Perhaps he is the aforementioned Rabbah bar Rav Huna, whose father was short (see Rav Huna), or they are two. Beitzah 29b: Rava bar Rav Huna Zuti expounded in Nehardea. Rav Nahman said, ‘Tell Abba’—meaning my colleague. Rav Nehemya bar Rav Yosef sent to him in Nehardea; see there.
